annotations.title: UOKiK and KNF fines of Polish banks

description: Use for fines imposed by UOKiK or KNF on a Polish bank, how many fines a bank had in the last 5 years and the sum, or which banks were fined most. For the KNF warnings list of unlicensed firms, use check_knf_warnings. For the BFG deposit guarantee, use check_bfg_guarantee. Fines imposed by the President of UOKiK (consumer protection) and by the Polish Financial Supervision Authority (KNF) on Polish banks described on finwire.pl, in the last 5 years: count and sum per bank (series finwire_bank_penalty_count; group companies such as mortgage banks, fund managers or leasing firms counted separately). With bank: the fines of that bank with the party verbatim from the source, amount (UOKiK press releases often give rounded amounts), dates, finality when the press release states it, and a link to the UOKiK press release or the KNF list. Matching uses current and former legal names (e.g. Santander Bank Polska = Erste Bank Polska); parties matched with lower confidence are left out. UOKiK fines start from the first press release read (the RSS feed has no history). Information only, not an assessment of the bank.

bank.description: Bank page slug on finwire.pl, e.g. pko-bp, mbank, ing, pekao, erste, millennium, alior, bnp-paribas, credit-agricole, velobank; omit for all banks.

limit.description: Fines to list for the bank, default 20.
